segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Lisa. I just wanted to confirm the seat count and timing before I send the order form over. Last we talked, you were at 48 users for the operations team, with go-live targeted for March 18.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We actually added two supervisors, so make it 50 seats. Same go-live date if onboarding can still fit before then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, 50 works. For onboarding, we have the admin session on March 5 and then two end-user trainings the week of March 11. That's included in the implementation fee we discussed, the $4,800 one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the annual subscription was what, $31,500 before tax?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. At 50 seats, it's $52.50 per user per month, billed annually, so $31,500 for the year. The pricing sheet matches that. No usage overage unless you go above 75,000 records a month, and you're tracking around 42,000 today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team will ask about payment terms. We usually do net 30 from invoice date. Is that acceptable?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 30 is fine. I'll note that in the billing tool and on the order form. The start date would be March 1, invoice issued on signature, and service term March 1 through February 28 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you make sure the invoice references PO 78421? They won't process it without that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I'll add PO 78421 to the order form and the invoice notes. Also, just confirming the contract term is 12 months, auto-renewal for another 12 unless either side gives 60 days notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. Send it to me and copy Mark in procurement. If it comes today, I can get signatures moving by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the order form in the next hour, copy Mark, and update the CRM with 50 seats, March 1 start, and net 30. Once it's signed, I'll introduce you to the implementation lead.
